import math

bool ascii_less(string a, string b)
    int[] left := a.codepoints()
    int[] right := b.codepoints()
    for: index < #left
        if index >= #right
            return false
        if left[index] != right[index]
            return left[index] < right[index]
    return #left < #right

const Scale := 137438953472

class Person(string id, string sex, int birth, string name, death := 0, string[] parents := [])
class Marriage(string first, string second, int start, end := 0, status := "current", died := "")
    bool contains(string id)
        return id == first or id == second

    string other(string id)
        return if id == first then second else first

class Family()
    persons := map<string, Person>()
    Marriage[] marriages := []

class Snapshot(string line, Family family)
class Apex(string id, int da, int db, shares := 0)
class Event(int year, int rank, string counterpart, string text)

bool has_id(const string[] ids, string sought)
    for id := ids[]
        if id == sought
            return true
    return false

string[] without_id(const string[] ids, string removed)
    return [for id := ids[] if id != removed then id]

Person | error person(const Family family, string id)
    match family.persons.get(id)
        Person found
            return found
        none
            return error("UNKNOWN PERSON {id}")

string life_years(const Person subject)
    return string(subject.birth) + "-" + (if subject.death == 0 then "" else string(subject.death))

string[] age_order(const Family family, const string[] ids)
    string[] keys := []
    for id := ids[]
        subject := person(family, id)
        keys = keys.append("{subject.birth} {id}")
    return [for key := keys.sorted()[] then key[5:]]

string[] score_order(const map<string, int> scores)
    string[] keys := []
    for id := scores.keys()[]
        match scores.get(id)
            int score
                keys = keys.append("{score:06.} {id}")
            none
                void
    return [for key := keys.sorted()[] then key[7:]]

string person_list(const Family family, const string[] ids)
    return if #ids == 0 then "-" else age_order(family, ids).join(" ")

string[] parents(const Family family, string id)
    subject := person(family, id)
    return subject.parents

string[] children(const Family family, string id)
    string[] result := []
    for subject := family.persons.values()[]
        if has_id(subject.parents, id)
            result = result.append(subject.id)
    return result

int common_parents(const Family family, string a, string b)
    count := 0
    second := parents(family, b)
    for ancestor := parents(family, a)[]
        if has_id(second, ancestor)
            count += 1
    return count

bool siblings(const Family family, string a, string b)
    return a != b and common_parents(family, a, b) > 0

string[] sibling_ids(const Family family, string id)
    return [for other := family.persons.keys()[] if siblings(family, id, other) then other]

int current_record(const Family family, string id)
    for: index < #family.marriages
        record := family.marriages[index]
        if record.status == "current" and record.contains(id)
            return int(index)
    return -1

string spouse(const Family family, string id)
    index := current_record(family, id)
    return if index < 0 then "" else family.marriages[index].other(id)

int last_record(const Family family, string a, string b)
    result := -1
    for: index < #family.marriages
        record := family.marriages[index]
        if record.contains(a) and record.contains(b)
            result = int(index)
    return result

string[] partners(const Family family, string id)
    map<string, string> latest
    for record := family.marriages[]
        if record.contains(id)
            .latest.set(record.other(id), record.status)
    string[] result := []
    for other := latest.keys()[]
        match latest.get(other)
            string status
                if status != "divorced"
                    result = result.append(other)
            none
                void
    return result

bool intersects(const string[] first, const string[] second)
    for id := first[]
        if has_id(second, id)
            return true
    return false

bool step_related(const Family family, const string[] first, const string[] second)
    for id := first[]
        if intersects(partners(family, id), second)
            return true
    return false

map<string, int> distances(const Family family, string start, bool upward)
    map<string, int> result
    .result.set(start, 0)
    queue := [start]
    nat head := 0
    while head < #queue
        id := queue[head]
        head += 1
        distance := 0
        match result.get(id)
            int found
                distance = found
            none
                void
        following := if upward then parents(family, id) else children(family, id)
        for other := following[]
            if not result.has(other)
                .result.set(other, distance + 1)
                queue = queue.append(other)
    return result

int distance_at(const map<string, int> values, string id)
    match values.get(id)
        int distance
            return distance
        none
            return -1

bool is_ancestor(const Family family, string a, string b)
    return a != b and distances(family, b, true).has(a)

string[] grandparents(const Family family, string id)
    up := distances(family, id, true)
    return [for other := up.keys()[] if distance_at(up, other) == 2 then other]

Apex | none apex(const Family family, string a, string b)
    first := distances(family, a, true)
    second := distances(family, b, true)
    if second.has(a)
        return Apex(a, 0, distance_at(second, a))
    if first.has(b)
        return Apex(b, distance_at(first, b), 0)
    best := ""
    da := 0
    db := 0
    for ancestor := first.keys().sorted()[]
        if not second.has(ancestor)
            continue
        left := distance_at(first, ancestor)
        right := distance_at(second, ancestor)
        if best == "" or left + right < da + db or (left + right == da + db and left < da)
            best = ancestor
            da = left
            db = right
    if best == ""
        return none
    shares := 0
    for ancestor := first.keys()[]
        if distance_at(first, ancestor) == da and distance_at(second, ancestor) == db
            shares += 1
    return Apex(best, da, db, shares)

string gendered(string male, string female, string neutral, string sex)
    return if sex == "M" then male elif sex == "F" then female else neutral

string generation_prefix(int generation)
    if generation == 1
        return ""
    result := ""
    for: index < generation - 2
        result += "great-"
    return result + "grand"

string ordinal(int number)
    first := ["first", "second", "third", "fourth", "fifth", "sixth", "seventh", "eighth", "ninth", "tenth"]
    if number <= 10
        return first[number - 1]
    suffix := "th"
    if not (11 <= number % 100 <= 13)
        if number % 10 == 1
            suffix = "st"
        elif number % 10 == 2
            suffix = "nd"
        elif number % 10 == 3
            suffix = "rd"
    return string(number) + suffix

string term(int da, int db, string sex)
    if da == 0 and db == 0
        return "self"
    if da == 0
        return generation_prefix(db) + gendered("father", "mother", "parent", sex)
    if db == 0
        return generation_prefix(da) + gendered("son", "daughter", "child", sex)
    if da == 1 and db == 1
        return gendered("brother", "sister", "sibling", sex)
    if da == 1
        return generation_prefix(db - 1) + gendered("uncle", "aunt", "pibling", sex)
    if db == 1
        return generation_prefix(da - 1) + gendered("nephew", "niece", "nibling", sex)
    removal := math.abs(da - db)
    suffix := ""
    if removal == 1
        suffix = " once removed"
    elif removal == 2
        suffix = " twice removed"
    elif removal >= 3
        suffix = " {removal} times removed"
    return ordinal(math.min(da, db) - 1) + " cousin" + suffix

string blood_term(const Apex common, string sex)
    prefix := if common.shares == 1 then "half-" elif common.shares >= 4 then "double " else ""
    return prefix + term(common.da, common.db, sex)

string[] relationship(const Family family, string a, string b, string sex)
    if a == b
        return ["self"]
    string[] result := []
    match apex(family, a, b)
        Apex common
            result = result.append(blood_term(common, sex))
        none
            void
    marriage := last_record(family, a, b)
    if marriage >= 0
        record := family.marriages[marriage]
        if record.status == "current"
            result = result.append(gendered("husband", "wife", "spouse", sex))
        elif record.status == "divorced"
            result = result.append(gendered("ex-husband", "ex-wife", "ex-spouse", sex))
        elif record.died == a
            result = result.append(gendered("late husband", "late wife", "late spouse", sex))
        else
            result = result.append(gendered("widower", "widow", "surviving spouse", sex))
    else
        for child := family.persons.values()[]
            if has_id(child.parents, a) and has_id(child.parents, b)
                result = result.append("co-parent")
                break
    first_parents := parents(family, a)
    second_parents := parents(family, b)
    first_partners := partners(family, a)
    second_partners := partners(family, b)
    if not has_id(second_parents, a) and intersects(first_partners, second_parents)
        result = result.append("step" + gendered("father", "mother", "parent", sex))
    if not has_id(first_parents, b) and intersects(second_partners, first_parents)
        result = result.append("step" + gendered("son", "daughter", "child", sex))
    if common_parents(family, a, b) == 0 and step_related(family, first_parents, second_parents)
        result = result.append("step" + gendered("brother", "sister", "sibling", sex))
    if not is_ancestor(family, a, b) and intersects(first_partners, grandparents(family, b))
        result = result.append("stepgrand" + gendered("father", "mother", "parent", sex))
    if not is_ancestor(family, b, a) and intersects(second_partners, grandparents(family, a))
        result = result.append("stepgrand" + gendered("son", "daughter", "child", sex))
    parent_in_law := false
    child_in_law := false
    sibling_in_law := false
    for partner := second_partners[]
        parent_in_law = parent_in_law or has_id(parents(family, partner), a)
        sibling_in_law = sibling_in_law or siblings(family, a, partner)
    for partner := first_partners[]
        child_in_law = child_in_law or has_id(parents(family, partner), b)
        sibling_in_law = sibling_in_law or siblings(family, partner, b)
    if parent_in_law
        result = result.append(gendered("father", "mother", "parent", sex) + "-in-law")
    if child_in_law
        result = result.append(gendered("son", "daughter", "child", sex) + "-in-law")
    if sibling_in_law
        result = result.append(gendered("brother", "sister", "sibling", sex) + "-in-law")
    return result

string relationship_text(const Family family, string a, string b)
    subject := person(family, a)
    terms := relationship(family, a, b, subject.sex)
    return if #terms == 0 then "no relation" else terms.join(", ")

int coefficient(const Family family, string a, string b, map<string, int> &memo)
    key := if ascii_less(a, b) then a + " " + b else b + " " + a
    match memo.get(key)
        int cached
            return cached
        none
            void
    first := person(family, a)
    second := person(family, b)
    result := 0
    if a == b
        inbred := 0
        if #first.parents == 2
            inbred = coefficient(family, first.parents[0], first.parents[1], &memo)
        result = (Scale + inbred) / 2
    else
        younger := if first.birth >= second.birth then first else second
        other := if first.birth >= second.birth then b else a
        for ancestor := younger.parents[]
            result += coefficient(family, ancestor, other, &memo)
        result /= 2
    .memo.set(key, result)
    return result

int inbreeding(const Family family, string id, map<string, int> &memo)
    up := parents(family, id)
    return if #up == 2 then coefficient(family, up[0], up[1], &memo) else 0

string fraction_text(int value)
    numerator := value
    denominator := Scale
    while denominator > 1 and numerator % 2 == 0
        numerator /= 2
        denominator /= 2
    return "{numerator}/{denominator}"

int lineage_length(const Family family, string id, map<string, int> &memo)
    match memo.get(id)
        int cached
            return cached
        none
            void
    result := 1
    for ancestor := parents(family, id)[]
        result = math.max(result, 1 + lineage_length(family, ancestor, &memo))
    .memo.set(id, result)
    return result

string with_lines(string header, const string[] lines)
    return header + (if #lines == 0 then "" else NL + lines.join(NL))

string | error modify(Family &family, string command, const string[] words)
    a := words[1]
    if command == "PERSON"
        if family.persons.has(a)
            return error("DUPLICATE PERSON {a}")
        birth := int(words[3])
        .family.persons.set(a, Person(a, words[2], birth, words[4]))
        return "ADDED {a} {words[4]} {words[2]} {birth}"
    first := try person(family, a)
    if command == "DEATH"
        year := int(words[2])
        if first.death != 0
            return error("ALREADY DECEASED {a}")
        if year < first.birth
            return error("BAD YEAR {a}")
        for record := family.marriages[]
            if record.contains(a) and (year < record.start or year < record.end)
                return error("BAD YEAR {a}")
        for child := children(family, a).sorted()[]
            descendant := person(family, child)
            if descendant.birth > year + 1
                return error("AFTER DEATH {child} {a}")
        first.death = year
        .family.persons.set(a, first)
        index := current_record(family, a)
        suffix := ""
        if index >= 0
            record := family.marriages[index]
            suffix = " spouse=" + record.other(a)
            record.end = year
            record.status = "widowed"
            record.died = a
            family.marriages[index] = record
        return "DIED {a} {year}" + suffix
    if command == "REMOVE"
        for id := family.persons.keys()[]
            subject := person(family, id)
            subject.parents = without_id(subject.parents, a)
            .family.persons.set(id, subject)
        family.marriages = [for record := family.marriages[] if not record.contains(a) then record]
        .family.persons.remove(a)
        return "REMOVED {a}"
    b := words[2]
    second := try person(family, b)
    if command == "PARENT"
        if a == b
            return error("SAME PERSON {a}")
        if has_id(first.parents, b)
            return error("ALREADY PARENT {a} {b}")
        if #first.parents == 2
            return error("TOO MANY PARENTS {a}")
        if is_ancestor(family, a, b)
            return error("CYCLE {a} {b}")
        if second.birth + 12 > first.birth
            return error("AGE GAP {a} {b}")
        if second.death != 0 and second.death + 1 < first.birth
            return error("AFTER DEATH {a} {b}")
        first.parents = first.parents.append(b)
        .family.persons.set(a, first)
        return "LINKED {a} {b} " + gendered("father", "mother", "parent", second.sex)
    if command == "UNPARENT"
        if not has_id(first.parents, b)
            return error("NOT PARENT {a} {b}")
        first.parents = without_id(first.parents, b)
        .family.persons.set(a, first)
        return "UNLINKED {a} {b}"
    year := int(words[3])
    if command == "SPOUSE"
        if a == b
            return error("SAME PERSON {a}")
        for subject := [first, second][]
            if subject.death != 0
                return error("DECEASED {subject.id}")
        for id := [a, b][]
            if spouse(family, id) != ""
                return error("ALREADY MARRIED {id}")
        if is_ancestor(family, a, b) or is_ancestor(family, b, a) or siblings(family, a, b)
            return error("CLOSE KIN {a} {b}")
        for subject := [first, second][]
            if year < subject.birth + 16
                return error("TOO YOUNG {subject.id}")
        for id := [a, b][]
            for record := family.marriages[]
                if record.contains(id) and record.end != 0 and record.end >= year
                    return error("BAD YEAR {id}")
        family.marriages = family.marriages.append(Marriage(a, b, year))
        return "MARRIED {a} {b} {year}"
    if spouse(family, a) != b
        return error("NOT MARRIED {a} {b}")
    index := current_record(family, a)
    record := family.marriages[index]
    if year <= record.start
        return error("BAD YEAR {a}")
    record.end = year
    record.status = "divorced"
    family.marriages[index] = record
    return "DIVORCED {a} {b} {year}"

void visit_tree(const Family family, string id, int depth, distinct<string> &seen, string[] &lines)
    string indent := " " * nat(2 * (depth + 1))
    if seen.has(id)
        lines = lines.append(indent + id + " (see above)")
        return
    .seen.add(id)
    subject := person(family, id)
    partner := spouse(family, id)
    lines = lines.append(indent + id + " " + subject.name + " " + life_years(subject) + (if partner == "" then "" else " = " + partner))
    for child := age_order(family, children(family, id))[]
        visit_tree(family, child, depth + 1, &seen, &lines)

void enter_pedigree(const Family family, string id, int number, int generation, int depth, distinct<string> &seen, string[] &lines)
    subject := person(family, id)
    .seen.add(id)
    lines = lines.append(" " * nat(2 * (generation + 1)) + "{number} {id} {subject.name} " + life_years(subject))
    if generation >= depth
        return
    string[] ordered := []
    for sex := ["M", "F", "X"][]
        for ancestor := subject.parents.sorted()[]
            parent := person(family, ancestor)
            if parent.sex == sex
                ordered = ordered.append(ancestor)
    for: index < #ordered
        enter_pedigree(family, ordered[index], 2 * number + int(index), generation + 1, depth, &seen, &lines)

string census_status(const Family family, string id, int year)
    result := "single"
    for record := family.marriages[]
        if record.contains(id) and record.start <= year
            result = if record.end == 0 or record.end > year then "married " + record.other(id) else record.status
    return result

string[] upward_path(const Family family, string start, string target)
    depths := distances(family, target, false)
    route := [start]
    current := start
    while current != target
        for ancestor := parents(family, current).sorted()[]
            if depths.has(ancestor) and distance_at(depths, ancestor) == distance_at(depths, current) - 1
                current = ancestor
                route = route.append(current)
                break
    return route

string query_global(const Family family, string command, const string[] words)
    if command == "TERM"
        da := int(words[1])
        db := int(words[2])
        return "TERM {da} {db} {words[3]} " + term(da, db, words[3])
    string[] lines := []
    if command == "CENSUS"
        year := int(words[1])
        for id := age_order(family, family.persons.keys())[]
            subject := person(family, id)
            if subject.birth <= year and (subject.death == 0 or subject.death > year)
                lines = lines.append("  {id} {year - subject.birth} " + census_status(family, id, year))
        return with_lines("CENSUS {year} {#lines}", lines)
    map<string, int> memo
    if command == "AUDIT"
        for record := family.marriages[]
            match apex(family, record.first, record.second)
                Apex common
                    first := person(family, record.first)
                    lines = lines.append("  marriage {record.first} {record.second} " + blood_term(common, first.sex))
                none
                    void
        for id := family.persons.keys().sorted()[]
            value := inbreeding(family, id, &memo)
            if value != 0
                lines = lines.append("  inbred {id} " + fraction_text(value))
        return with_lines("AUDIT {#lines}", lines)
    living := 0
    links := 0
    founders := 0
    generations := 0
    couples := 0
    for subject := family.persons.values()[]
        if subject.death == 0
            living += 1
        links += int(#subject.parents)
        if #subject.parents == 0
            founders += 1
        generations = math.max(generations, lineage_length(family, subject.id, &memo))
    for record := family.marriages[]
        if record.status == "current"
            couples += 1
    return "STATS persons={family.persons.size()} living={living} links={links} couples={couples} founders={founders} generations={generations}"

string | error query(const Family family, string command, const string[] words)
    if command == "TERM" or command == "CENSUS" or command == "STATS" or command == "AUDIT"
        return query_global(family, command, words)
    a := words[1]
    first := try person(family, a)
    string[] lines := []
    map<string, int> memo
    if command == "INFO"
        lines = lines.append("  parents: " + person_list(family, first.parents))
        for record := family.marriages[]
            if record.contains(a)
                end := if record.end == 0 then "" else string(record.end)
                lines = lines.append("  marriage: " + record.other(a) + " {record.start}-{end} {record.status}")
        lines = lines.append("  children: " + person_list(family, children(family, a)))
        lines = lines.append("  siblings: " + person_list(family, sibling_ids(family, a)))
        lines = lines.append("  inbreeding: " + fraction_text(inbreeding(family, a, &memo)))
        return with_lines("INFO {a} {first.name} {first.sex} " + life_years(first), lines)
    if command == "RELATION" or command == "KINSHIP" or command == "PATH" or command == "COMMON"
        b := words[2]
        second := try person(family, b)
        if command == "RELATION"
            return "RELATION {a} {b}: " + relationship_text(family, a, b)
        if command == "KINSHIP"
            return "KINSHIP {a} {b} " + fraction_text(coefficient(family, a, b, &memo))
        if command == "PATH"
            match apex(family, a, b)
                none
                    return "PATH {a} {b} none"
                Apex common
                    down := upward_path(family, b, common.id)
                    down = down[0:<int(#down) - 1]
                    string[] route := upward_path(family, a, common.id).concat(down[::-1])
                    return "PATH {a} {b} {common.da + common.db}: " + route.join(" ")
        up_a := distances(family, a, true)
        up_b := distances(family, b, true)
        map<string, int> nearest
        for ancestor := up_a.keys()[]
            if not up_b.has(ancestor)
                continue
            has_common_child := false
            for child := children(family, ancestor)[]
                if up_a.has(child) and up_b.has(child)
                    has_common_child = true
            if not has_common_child
                .nearest.set(ancestor, distance_at(up_a, ancestor) + distance_at(up_b, ancestor))
        for ancestor := score_order(nearest)[]
            lines = lines.append("  {ancestor} {distance_at(up_a, ancestor)} {distance_at(up_b, ancestor)}")
        return with_lines("COMMON {a} {b} {#lines}", lines)
    if command == "RELATIVES" or command == "WHO"
        sought := if command == "WHO" then words[2:].join(" ") else ""
        for other := family.persons.keys().sorted()[]
            if other == a
                continue
            subject := person(family, other)
            terms := relationship(family, other, a, subject.sex)
            if command == "RELATIVES"
                if #terms > 0
                    lines = lines.append("  {other}: " + terms.join(", "))
            else
                neutral := relationship(family, other, a, "X")
                for: index < #terms
                    if terms[index] == sought or neutral[index] == sought
                        lines = lines.append("  {other}: " + terms[index])
                        break
        header := command + " " + a + (if command == "WHO" then " " + sought else "") + " {#lines}"
        return with_lines(header, lines)
    if command == "ANCESTORS" or command == "DESCENDANTS" or command == "GENERATIONS" or command == "TREE"
        upward := command == "ANCESTORS"
        depths := distances(family, a, upward)
        .depths.remove(a)
        if command == "TREE"
            distinct<string> seen
            visit_tree(family, a, 0, &seen, &lines)
            return with_lines("TREE {a} {depths.size()}", lines)
        if command == "GENERATIONS"
            for: 1 <= generation <= 19
                count := 0
                living := 0
                earliest := 2025
                latest := 1800
                for other := depths.keys()[]
                    if distance_at(depths, other) == generation
                        subject := person(family, other)
                        count += 1
                        if subject.death == 0
                            living += 1
                        earliest = math.min(earliest, subject.birth)
                        latest = math.max(latest, subject.birth)
                if count > 0
                    lines = lines.append("  {generation} {count} {living} {earliest}-{latest}")
            return with_lines("GENERATIONS {a} {#lines}", lines)
        for other := score_order(depths)[]
            generation := distance_at(depths, other)
            subject := person(family, other)
            kin := if upward then term(0, generation, subject.sex) else term(generation, 0, subject.sex)
            lines = lines.append("  {generation} {other} {kin}")
        return with_lines("{command} {a} {#lines}", lines)
    if command == "COUSINS"
        degree := int(words[2])
        map<string, int> matches
        for other := family.persons.keys()[]
            if other == a
                continue
            match apex(family, other, a)
                Apex common
                    if common.da >= 2 and common.db >= 2 and math.min(common.da, common.db) - 1 == degree
                        .matches.set(other, math.abs(common.da - common.db))
                none
                    void
        for other := score_order(matches)[]
            subject := person(family, other)
            match apex(family, other, a)
                Apex common
                    lines = lines.append("  {other} " + blood_term(common, subject.sex))
                none
                    void
        return with_lines("COUSINS {a} {degree} {#lines}", lines)
    if command == "SIBLINGS"
        earlier := 0
        for other := age_order(family, family.persons.keys())[]
            if other == a
                continue
            shared := common_parents(family, a, other)
            kind := ""
            if shared == 2
                kind = "full"
            elif shared == 1
                kind = "half"
            elif step_related(family, first.parents, parents(family, other))
                kind = "step"
            if kind == ""
                continue
            subject := person(family, other)
            if shared > 0 and (subject.birth < first.birth or (subject.birth == first.birth and ascii_less(other, a)))
                earlier += 1
            lines = lines.append("  {other} {kind} {subject.birth}")
        return with_lines("SIBLINGS {a} {#lines} order={earlier + 1}", lines)
    if command == "PEDIGREE"
        depth := int(words[2])
        distinct<string> seen
        enter_pedigree(family, a, 1, 0, depth, &seen, &lines)
        return with_lines("PEDIGREE {a} {depth} entries={#lines} distinct={seen.size()}", lines)
    if command == "TIMELINE"
        events := [Event(first.birth, 0, "", "born")]
        for record := family.marriages[]
            if not record.contains(a)
                continue
            other := record.other(a)
            events = events.append(Event(record.start, 1, other, "married " + other))
            if record.status == "divorced"
                events = events.append(Event(record.end, 3, other, "divorced " + other))
            elif record.status == "widowed" and record.died == other
                events = events.append(Event(record.end, 4, other, "widowed " + other))
        offspring := children(family, a)
        for child := offspring[]
            subject := person(family, child)
            events = events.append(Event(subject.birth, 2, child, "child " + child))
        for other := first.parents.concat(offspring)[]
            subject := person(family, other)
            if subject.death != 0 and subject.death >= first.birth and (first.death == 0 or subject.death <= first.death)
                label := if has_id(first.parents, other) then "parent" else "child"
                events = events.append(Event(subject.death, 5, other, "lost {label} {other}"))
        if first.death != 0
            events = events.append(Event(first.death, 6, "", "died"))
        map<string, Event> indexed
        for event := events[]
            .indexed.set("{event.year} {event.rank} {event.counterpart}", event)
        for key := indexed.keys().sorted()[]
            match indexed.get(key)
                Event event
                    lines = lines.append("  {event.year} {event.text}")
                none
                    void
        return with_lines("TIMELINE {a} {#lines}", lines)
    route := words[2]
    current := [a]
    for step := route.split(".")[]
        sex := ""
        kind := step
        if step == "father" or step == "mother"
            kind = "parent"
            sex = if step == "father" then "M" else "F"
        elif step == "son" or step == "daughter"
            kind = "child"
            sex = if step == "son" then "M" else "F"
        elif step == "brother" or step == "sister"
            kind = "sibling"
            sex = if step == "brother" then "M" else "F"
        elif step == "husband" or step == "wife"
            kind = "spouse"
            sex = if step == "husband" then "M" else "F"
        distinct<string> collected
        for id := current[]
            string[] targets := []
            if kind == "parent"
                targets = parents(family, id)
            elif kind == "child"
                targets = children(family, id)
            elif kind == "sibling"
                targets = sibling_ids(family, id)
            else
                partner := spouse(family, id)
                if partner != ""
                    targets = [partner]
            for target := targets[]
                subject := person(family, target)
                if sex == "" or subject.sex == sex
                    .collected.add(target)
        current = collected.values()
    current = without_id(current, a).sorted()
    for other := current[]
        lines = lines.append("  {other}: " + relationship_text(family, other, a))
    return with_lines("FIND {a} {route} {#lines}", lines)

family := Family()
Snapshot[] history := []
int count
scan(&count)
for: command_index < count
    string line
    scan(&line)
    words := line.split(" ")
    command := words[0]
    if command == "UNDO"
        if #history == 0
            println("ERROR NOTHING TO UNDO")
        else
            top := #history - 1
            saved := history[top]
            family = saved.family
            history = history[0:<top]
            println("UNDONE " + saved.line)
    elif has_id(["PERSON", "DEATH", "REMOVE", "PARENT", "UNPARENT", "SPOUSE", "DIVORCE"], command)
        before := family
        match modify(&family, command, words)
            string output
                history = history.append(Snapshot(line, before))
                println(output)
            error problem
                println("ERROR " + problem.message)
    else
        match query(family, command, words)
            string output
                println(output)
            error problem
                println("ERROR " + problem.message)
